card.name: With after patient positioning or procedure verbs
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after a body-position or procedure verb such as supine, prone, lie, isolated or inflated. It is strongest in instructions on how to place a patient or perform a procedure.

modes.label: Positioning the patient
modes.description: "with" after supine, prone or lie, introducing the position of limbs or head.
modes.example: patient supine<< with>> arms above the head. Begin PET scanning

modes.label: Procedure steps
modes.description: "with" or "of" after a step verb or noun in a procedure description, naming the material or form used.
modes.example: Entire tooth surface is cleansed and isolated<< with>> cotton rolls to ensure a tooth surface which

modes.label: Other scattered cases
modes.description: Occasional other linking words or pieces in similar instructional text.
modes.example: in a supine position with<< the>> head tilted down if necessary, before administration
